name: product-catalog-rendering-strategies
description: Next.js application demonstrating CSR, SSR, and SSG

scripts.dev:
echo "
--- 🚀 RUNNING MULTIPLE NEXT.JS APPS ---

The applications are located in their respective folders. To start the development servers, please run one of the following commands:

👉 npm run dev:csr  (Starts Client-Side Rendering App)
👉 npm run dev:ssr  (Starts Server-Side Rendering App)
👉 npm run dev:ssg  (Starts Static Site Generation App)

Alternatively, you can cd into the specific directory (e.g., cd csr) and run 'npm run dev'.
"
